title: Chapter 16 Key Mold
content:
Chapter 16 Key Mold

He browsed the [Trading House] and [Chat Channel] out of boredom.

Half an hour passed quickly.

He accidentally discovered that there were players who used clay to exchange for resources, which made Wang Shuo laugh.

Suddenly, Wang Shuo slapped his forehead and laughed, "Yeah, why didn't I think of it."

There is something to do even when it rains!

He quickly found the player who consigned clay in the [Trading House] and found that the resource he wanted to exchange was water.

Wang Shuo no longer hesitated and directly exchanged all his clay.

He immediately started making clay and finished it quickly, getting a total of 86 pieces of clay.

To make 400 tiles, only 40 pieces of clay are needed.

He silently said "make tiles" in his heart.

[10 tiles = clay 86/1, wood 400/1]

[Do you want to make it? 】

"Yes."

Influenced by the profession of "bricklayer" and "pottery mastery", his current production speed is extremely fast. In less than a few minutes, 400 tiles were made.

He hurried to the trading house and exchanged for bronze ore.

[Bronze ore +100, tiles -400]

He came to the workshop and began to smelt bronze ore. He found that a large amount of charcoal was needed, and it would be better to have coal.

He searched in the trading house and really found it.

However, the other party had to exchange food. Wang Shuo reluctantly used 5 units of meat, 10 eggs, 100 grams of salt, 10 eels, and some loaches to exchange for 200 units of coal.

[Bronze ingot: bronze ore 100/2, coal 200/1]

(At least 10 pieces can be made at a time, requiring a furnace and a forging table.)

At present, Wang Shuo has not found any other uses for bronze ore, so he chose to make all of it.

[Bronze Ingot +50, Bronze Ore -100, Coal -50]

He opened the [Synthesis Formula] again.

[10 Bronze Keys = 1 Bronze Ingot + 1 Coal + 10 Bronze Key Molds]

"What? Wang Defa..."

What a pitfall! Wang Shuo was a little upset. It turned out that he also needed a key mold. He was careless!

Before, he was so focused on opening the treasure chest and making the key that he didn't look at the "Synthesis Formula" carefully. Now he was a little dumbfounded.

In desperation, he had to go to the trading house to see if there was any relevant information.

Disappointingly, there was no information about the bronze key.

There was a person who consigned the bronze treasure chest, but he ended up putting up a high price, asking for 1,000 wood and 1,000 stone.

Wang Shuo just snorted coldly: "At this price, only a fool would trade with him."

After thinking it over, Wang Shuo had to issue a high price reward in the [Chat Channel].

Wang Shuo: "Who has the 'bronze key mold'? Message me privately. I'll buy it at a high price!"

"Brother, you are so awesome that you have started making bronze keys. 666!"

"Boss, if you have extra keys, remember to sell me one. I have a bronze treasure chest."

"Same here. I have 3 bronze treasure chests."

...

For a while, the atmosphere in the [chat channel] was quite active, but there was no information about the "bronze key mold".

Wang Shuo was unwilling to send a message every few minutes.

It has come to this point, and we can't give up halfway.

At this time, a player named Liu Xue with ID: 1042 got into a dilemma. She happened to have the "bronze key mold" in her hand. This was the item she got from the wooden treasure chest.

Originally, she wanted to keep it for her own use. She had learned that after upgrading the stone house, she could unlock the tool table and forging table, and then make bronze keys.

But at this moment, she had just upgraded the wooden house, and there were few resources left, and the acid rain outside made it difficult for her to collect supplies.

More importantly, she hadn't eaten for a day. After struggling for a long time, she made a difficult decision.

"Brother, are you there?"

This soft and cute voice made Wang Shuo's bones soft.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but recall an experience of staying in a hotel before.

Wang Shuo took a while to calm down and replied: "Yes."

"I have a bronze key mold."

Wang Shuo was delighted and patted his thigh with his hand, thinking: "Finally I've waited for you!"

"What do you want to change?" Wang Shuo said in a calm tone.

"I don't know, but I want to survive." Liu Xue was a freshman girl. She was just pulled into this strange place and was also panicked for a while, but when she was in school, she had good grades and was good at learning, observing and imitating.

She quickly mastered the skills of survival, but she still had no idea about the later development. After all, she had never played survival games, or even games.

"Is that so?" Wang Shuo fell silent for a moment. This kind of seemingly undemanding person is the most difficult to deal with. Wang Shuo was already alert in his heart, guarding against the gentle trap that the other party might set for him.

"Think about it, what do you lack the most? If I have it, we can trade it."

"I lack food, water, and materials for upgrading the advanced stone house now."

Wang Shuo rolled his eyes and thought to himself: "You might as well say you lack everything."

The other party seemed to have a weak tone, but he obviously had the suspicion of asking for too much.

Wang Shuo thought for a moment and replied, "I don't have much food now, so I'll give you 2 units of meat, 2 units of rice, and 100 units of water. As for materials, I'll give you 100 tiles and 100 stones."

The bronze key mold drawing, after learning it, he can make bronze keys continuously. Thinking of the difficulty of making this key, Wang Shuo must be the only one for a long time, so no matter how much it costs, it is worth it.

"Brother, can you give me some more stones? I just checked, upgrading the stone house requires 10 wood, 200 stones, and 100 tiles. I don't have stones now, so you should be a good person to the end and send the Buddha to the west!"

Wang Shuo was too lazy to argue with her anymore. He currently had 545 units of stone, so he readily agreed.

Wang Shuo looked at the warehouse. There were no tiles, but there were still materials.

He silently said "make tiles" in his heart.

[10 tiles = clay 46/1, wood 360/1]

Make them all directly.

[Tile +460, Clay -46, Wood -46]

The two put the corresponding materials into the transaction box and clicked OK.

[Bronze Key Mold Production Drawing +1, Stone -200, Tile -100, Meat -2, Rice -2. ]

[Do you want to learn "Bronze Key Mold Production Drawing"? ]

"Yes."

[Bronze Key Mold = 1 Wood + 10 Sand]

Seeing the materials needed for the mold, Wang Shuo finally breathed a sigh of relief.

He thought of a big guy who was born in the desert. Sand was everywhere, as if it was free. He even exchanged tiles with him and asked if he wanted sand.

At that time, Wang Shuo also complained whether the other party was stupid.

Now it seems that the system said that every material will be useful, and it is indeed true.

So he quickly contacted the player named Feng Chao with ID: 3456.

"Brother, is it raining acid in your desert?"

"Yes, big brother, thank you for your tiles, otherwise I might be finished."

"Uh, you're welcome, we also take what we need, I want to exchange some sand with you now."

"Big brother wants sand? Did I hear it right? This thing is also useful? How much do you want? I'll give it to you."

Wang Shuo rarely met such a straightforward guy, and he felt a little embarrassed.

"How can that be? It's not easy for you in the desert, I'll exchange water with you!"

"It's okay, I found an iron mine in the desert, and I won't starve to death for the time being."

Wang Shuo was actually a little envious for a while. He has not found any minerals so far. I thought the other party was poor now, but I didn't expect that the other party actually had a mine at home.

Okay, I'm superficial! Everyone has their own fate.

"Sure! Brother, we can cooperate for a long time!" Wang Shuo's mind became active.

"Well, okay!"
